name: rainbow

attributes.attribute: appears whenever the sword is swung

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The hero Fergus owned a great sword that flung rainbows with every sweep. Each strike hurled bands of color over the sky. One blow sliced the tops off the Midlands mountains. That swing left the flat hills that still guard those lands.

okr.objective: Account of the hero Fergus and the sword that cast rainbows while trimming the Midlands mountains.
key_results: State that Fergus carries a great sword that sent rainbows on every swing.
Cite the sword shearing the mountain tops off the peaks.
Record the flat-topped hills left behind in that region.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
